mapper.select: SELECT borrow_id, user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_return_time, actual_return_time, borrow_status FROM borrow_record WHERE borrow_id = #{borrowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record ( user_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_return_time, actual_return_time, borrow_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueReturnTime}, #{actualReturnTime}, #{borrowStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET actual_return_time = #{actualReturnTime}, borrow_status = 1 WHERE borrow_id = #{borrowId}
